decisions.mark: concludes that in a DEFAULT build there is no indirection at all — mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are preprocessor macros expanding directly to calloc and free
decisions.detail: QUOTE: **Default (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off):** `include/mbedtls/platform.h:167` defines `mbedtls_calloc` as a plain macro for `calloc`, and `:166` does the same for `free`. The call compiles straight to libc, with no indirection. | WHY: The answer states that in the default build, mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are plain macros expanding directly to calloc and free, with no indirection. || QUOTE: **Default (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off):** `include/mbedtls/platform.h:167` defines `mbedtls_calloc` as a plain macro for `calloc`, and `:166` does the same for `free`. The call compiles straight to libc, with no indirection. | WHY: The answer states that in the default build mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are plain macros for calloc and free, with no indirection.

decisions.mark: distinguishes the two ways to substitute an allocator — a COMPILE-time pair of macros versus a RUNTIME pair of function pointers — and states that they are mutually exclusive
decisions.detail: QUOTE: Two routes, one per row: ... Compile time | Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` / `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` ... Run time | Call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)`. | WHY: The answer separates compile-time macros from a runtime setter, but never says the two are mutually exclusive. It actually has the runtime pointers sitting behind the same `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` setting. || QUOTE: Two routes, one per row: ... Compile time | Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` / `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` ... Run time | Call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(calloc_fn, free_fn)`. | WHY: The answer distinguishes compile-time macros from the runtime function-pointer setter, but it never says they are mutually exclusive. It actually describes the runtime setter as operating on top of the `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` configuration. || QUOTE: Two routes, one per row: ... Compile time | Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` / `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` ...
